Editable controls

Native controls and seven MotionCore entries share the same renderer. Parameters include per-stage duration/rate, independent actor/object visibility/transforms/opacity/blur/path motion, world joint offsets and per-joint keys (linear/smooth), camera keys, seated-pose blend, coach travel, focus, smoke, chair position, colors and isolated boot replacement. Exact factory definitions are in docs/factory-defaults-v87.json.

Refinement decision

Recommended: improve mannequin anatomy and camera/occlusion first, then clear earlier cutout integration, tree wind/blur and house zoom/parallax issues. These are structural fidelity bottlenecks; surface sharpening or extra effects will not correct them.

Alternative: prioritize the earlier cutout/tree/house backlog first if those opening scenes matter most to the next demo. Neither refinement route has been started. No further footage should be added during the checkpoint review.
